about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hello! I am Mamadou FOFANA, a passionate full-stack developer specializing in creating modern, high-performance, and intuitive web and mobile applications. My goal is to design solutions that combine efficiency, user experience, and scalability.
about.p2: I have worked with several technologies such as Next.js, React.js, React Native, Django, Spring Boot (Java), and PostgreSQL/MySQL. I design secure REST APIs (JWT authentication) and integrate web/mobile frontends.
about.p3: Curious and rigorous, I love taking on technical challenges, continuous learning, and working in a team to deliver impactful products. I am also interested in cybersecurity and knowledge sharing.

list.title: Affiliation System
list.description: A comprehensive affiliation system with distinct interfaces for Admin and Partners. Developed with React and Django, it allows the Admin to manage users and payments, while Partners can track their bonuses, leads generated via their links, and view their performance evolution.

list.title: CoursClick
list.description: Landing page for CoursClick, a university platform for attendance management and academic processes. Discover interactive video demonstrations of the interface and frontend directly on the page, with secure access to multi-university features.
